cases.speech: Notes from the design review. We looked at three options for the new onboarding flow. The first option was a single long page with all the permissions and settings, uh, which felt overwhelming for new users. The second option was a step by step wizard with a progress bar at the top. Most people preferred this one because it's easier to follow and you always know how many steps are left. The third option was to skip onboarding entirely and ask for permissions only when they're needed, um, but we worried that people would get stuck the first time the hotkey doesn't work. So the decision is to go with the wizard. Scratch that, the decision is to go with the wizard but let people skip the optional steps like the hotkey and the dictionary. Action items are, Maria will create the mockups by Thursday, James will check how long the model download takes on a slow connection, and I will write the copy for each step. We'll meet again next Tuesday to review the mockups.
